metadata.ssd:note: Committed, diffable MapLibre style for the settlement-change viewer. Palette, ramp midpoint and layer order live here; app.js swaps the change-fill colour expression per period at runtime (setPaintProperty) and retints layers for dark mode. No glyphs/sprite: town labels are DOM markers (system fonts, zero font bytes), so there are no symbol/icon layers. The 'aggregates' source ships empty; the build publishes per-year building counts (c2016, c2018, ...) as feature attributes that app.js differences into the diverging ramp. The 'places' source (epoch-linked example boxes) is built at runtime from data/examples.json. Africa context: the continent is a single DISSOLVED silhouette (NE 110m country polys unioned — no internal borders, so nothing doubles up with SSD's own 50m boundary). It reads via a land/ocean tone difference (ocean = background water tone; land = ramp-neutral) plus a hairline coastline; only South Sudan carries an actual boundary line, keeping the emphasis on SSD. Rivers: NE 10m centerlines, SSD Nile network only, in a cooler water tone (distinct from the warm boundary grey; never saturated blue — docs §4 trap) and only from mid-zoom so the continental view stays clean.
